page.overview:
Who is Corf Binalie?

Corf Binalie was a Human male and the son of Pilester Binalie and lived on the planet Cartao. When he first met the Jedi, Jafer Torles, he was in awe of him, but after a Republic gunship destroyed his family's Spaarti Creations facility, he lost faith in his former idol.
